# SliderLib:onFocus

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.2</span></div>

Function called when the focus is changed.

```lua
field:onFocus(handler)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `handler` |  | yes | function(state) |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local line = form.addLine("Slider line")
local value = 10
local field = form.addSliderField(line, nil, 0, 100, function() return value end, function(newValue) value = newValue end)
field:onFocus(function(state) print("onFocus .. " .. state))
```
